title: Timing supplies two endpoint directions under a rotating reduced model
statement: A single spatial profile couples instantaneous amplitude and phase. Reduced dotz=(-lambda+iOmega)z+Bu has a two-dimensional finite-time Gramian iff nonzero rotation; established control theory. Source mHW timed-pulse condition numbers1.94,6.14,27.11 for states19,22,27 give target.001rad results.000998552,.001000584,.001053507 with relative amplitude perturbations1.53e-6,.64e-6,21.21e-6. Strong ordinary constrained two-pulse least squares uses the SAME information and matches; no algorithm advantage, calibrated RF controller or universal instantaneous phase/amplitude independence.

requires: Symmetric medium under ky sign reversal at equal frequency with Pplus=P(1+u)/2 and Pminus=P(1-u)/2, |u|<=1; one fixed signed spatial momentum channel.
Reported nonlinear mHW and passive-temperature exploratory floating-point models, specified fixed seeds, times and steps; source execution is reported rather than independently replayed.
Physically valid resonant momentum transfer, species-resolved local heating, stored wave dressing and source-to-zonal kernel must be independently acquired before physical application.

Five fixed-seed descriptive heat intervals all include zero; long-time/coarse-step failures remain. Available final and two confirmed individual originals only; missing bundle/code/tests/proof/source-ledger/logs are UNRECEIVED. costs: Charge both beams and total absorbed power, real local heating mismatch, complete calibration, sensing, future-branch rollouts and actuator limits equally to strong ordinary control.
Reported model grids/time steps and finite tests do not give rigorous PDE intervals, stationary turbulence statistics, reactor power forecasts or useful confinement benefit.
contract.units: u is dimensionless signed beam imbalance at fixed total power; ky is inverse metres, physical force is newtons, model phase is radians, Q_T is passive model-temperature flux. Source physical estimates and dimensionless reduced-model quantities are not interchangeable.
